mapper.select: SELECT s.role_id,o.id,o.org_path AS path,o.enabled AS active FROM iam_role_scope_org s JOIN iam_org o ON o.id=s.org_id AND o.tenant_id=s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.role_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.role_id,o.id

SELECT s.role_id,o.id,o.org_path AS path,(o.enabled AND o.org_type='COMPANY') AS active FROM iam_role_scope_company s JOIN iam_org o ON o.id=s.company_id AND o.tenant_id=s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.role_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.role_id,o.id

SELECT DISTINCT r.id,r.data_scope_type AS type FROM iam_role r JOIN iam_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id AND ur.tenant_id=r.tenant_id JOIN iam_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id=ur.tenant_id JOIN iam_role_permission p ON p.role_id=r.id AND p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND u.id=#{user} AND u.enabled AND r.enabled AND p.permission=#{permission} ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 201
SELECT count(*) FROM iam_org WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND enabled AND org_type='COMPANY' AND id IN #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_role_scope_org WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND role_id=#{id}
DELETE FROM iam_role_scope_company WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND role_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_role SET data_scope_type=#{type},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND NOT protected
